jobs.title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema. Warum diese Rolle Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf. Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben. Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden. Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows. Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen. Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche. Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment. Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen. Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten. Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert. Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt lie

jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. jobs.title: Senior Adviseur Energie En Laadinfrastructuur Goederenvervoer
jobs.description: Werken aan de energietransitie in transport. De transportsector staat voor een fundamentele verandering. Elektrificatie en de ontwikkeling van laadinfrastructuur zijn cruciaal voor de toekomst van het goederenvervoer. Panteia ondersteunt overheden, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven met onafhankelijk onderzoek en advies. Voor ons team Transport en Mobiliteit zoeken wij een senior adviseur die dit werkveld verder uitbouwt. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van energie, logistiek en beleid. Denk aan de ontwikkeling van laadpleinen, depotladen en de integratie van energie in logistieke systemen. Jij: leidt onderzoeks- en adviesprojecten van offerte tot oplevering; stuurt op kwaliteit, planning en budget van projecten; vertaalt beleidsvragen naar concrete onderzoeksopzetten en werkplannen; ontwikkelt nieuwe proposities rond laden en energie in transport; onderhoudt en bouwt relaties met opdrachtgevers zoals ministeries, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven; speelt een actieve rol in acquisitie en het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten; werkt samen met nationale en - waar relevant - Europese partners. Deze vacature daagt jou uit …om op strategisch niveau bij te dragen aan de oplossing van grote maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je richt je hierbij op een breed spectrum van goederenwegtransport tot energietransitie vraagstukken als gevolg van strengere klimaat- en energiedoelen. jobs.description: At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. jobs.description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client. OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et technique

jobs.title: DevOps & Data Architecture - Intern/Fulltime
jobs.description: About Heidi Systems Heidi Systems is building the data infrastructure layer for buildings and energy. We help property owners and managers digitize metering, consumption data, reporting and billing in one of Europe's largest and most outdated infrastructure markets. We're hiring a senior engineer to own DevOps and data infrastructure. You'll be responsible for how our systems get built, deployed, monitored and kept running. And you'll make the architecture calls together with the founders. Tasks What you'll own • Our deployment pipeline and production environment, end to end (CI/CD, containers, servers) • Monitoring, alerting and incident response, so problems show up before customers notice them • Data ingestion and processing for meter, gateway and building data, including MQTT/IoT streams • Database operations: Postgres setup, clustering, backups, performance • Backend services in Go and TypeScript • Validating and transforming high-volume device and consumption data • Debugging real-world issues across gateways, MQTT, APIs and databases • Internal tooling that automates our operations • Architecture decisions with the founding team, plus the engineering standards the rest of the team builds on Requirements Who we're looking for You've run production infrastructure before and you know what breaks at 2am. You're a great fit if you: • Have several years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, platform or backend role with production responsibility • Have built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments yourself • Write strong Go and/or TypeScript • Have run Postgres (or a comparable relational database) in production • Have set up monitoring and logging and handled real incidents • Can design a system from scratch and defend the choices Bonus: MQTT, IoT or time-series data, bare-metal/VPS setups (we run on Hetzner), experience in energy or real estate

jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value. Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rathe

jobs.description: Hi there! We are Testlio , a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work. At the moment, we're working with Uber to test new EV charging scenarios within the Uber Driver app — a feature currently being rolled out gradually. We're looking for already registered and active Uber drivers in France who drive an Electric Vehicle to help us ensure this feature works as expected in your region. Your feedback will be valuable in ensuring other drivers have a smooth experience using this new functionality. Device Requirements: iPhone running iOS 26 or above (tablets and iPads are not allowed) To participate in this project, you will need to create an account on our platform. Through this account, we can assign you testing tasks. You will be asked to use our website for defect tracking and will receive materials to prepare you for testing. Payrate: $27 USD/hr You will be paid per hour, not per issue/bug you find. That way, you get paid even if you don't find any bugs. We will reimburse you for any amount spent at charging stations while completing the testing scenarios. You can choose to be paid via PayPal or Payoneer for tasks completed on our website. Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio Schedule : You can create your own schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you. Location : Testlio is a 100% remote company. You can work from anywhere. Growth : You'll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career. Payment : You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. Requirements Age : At least 18 years old. Location : Must be physically located anywhere in France. You must be an existing, active Uber driver. You must own/drive an Electric Vehicle. Availability : Up to 10 hours total — testing may happen across multiple days, not all in one sitting. Cadence

jobs.title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. jobs.description: Du liebst es, Events auf die Beine zu stellen, und weißt, wie man Social-Media-Kanäle lebendig hält? Dann passt du zu uns. Als Marketing Manager sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Messen und Veranstaltungen reibungslos laufen und unsere Social-Media-Kanäle konsequent bespielt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit der Marketingleitung zusammen, hältst im Team die Fäden zusammen und wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics. You do not need to be an AI expert. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do. We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). jobs.title: AI-Native Software Engineer (Human)
jobs.description: What's it about? At Event Inc, we make meetings, events and business travel easier. Our platform connects companies with hotels, venues and service providers and automates processes that would otherwise take days. We work AI-first: AI agents aren’t an experiment for us, they’re a core part of our everyday engineering. As a AI-Native Software Engineer (Human) you use AI agents to build features across repositories, languages and systems that genuinely help our customers. And you always stay accountable for the result: AI writes along, you decide. Your role Build new features spec-first: define requirements and edge cases, implement with AI, review critically, and ship in small, clean steps. Get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar codebases and languages with AI support, and refactor across repositories. Integrate external APIs, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure) and SaaS tools securely and cleanly, including secrets and access management. Own reliability: monitoring, structured debugging and safe releases, so problems are caught before customers notice. Work directly with Product, Design and non-technical stakeholders to turn unclear requirements into clear solutions. Make the whole team more AI-fluent by sharing actively your agents, tools, workflows and learnings in code reviews and team syncs. What we like Several years of experience as a AI-Native Software Engineer and a solid foundation in clean, testable code Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and a healthy skepticism toward unverified output Experience with API and cloud integrations as well as monitoring and debugging in production Pragmatism: realistic commitments, raising blockers early, keeping quality high even under time pressure Open communication: you raise concerns with data and then fully commit (disagree & commit) A healthy approach to mistakes: you learn from them, share them openly and turn them into better processes Excellent English skills; German is a plus What you like AI-first engineering: A

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI REMOTE, United States JOB OVERVIEW Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it. Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there. You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not. The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. jobs.description: Bigfish is op zoek naar jou! Een enthousiaste stagiair Illustratie/design. Wil jij meewerken aan het ontwikkelen van illustraties en visuele concepten? Als stagiair bij Bigfish ben je echt onderdeel van het team en kun je waardevolle ervaring opdoen in de commerciële sector. Let op: deze stage is uitsluitend bedoeld voor studenten die tijdens de stageperiode staan ingeschreven aan een mbo- of hbo-opleiding. Sollicitaties van afgestudeerden kunnen we helaas niet in behandeling nemen. Taken Wat ga je doen? Ondersteunen bij het maken van illustraties, (interactieve) infographics en storyboards voor animatieprojecten. Samenwerken in een team om ideeën visueel vorm te geven. Je leert hoe je ruwe concepten kunt omzetten in aantrekkelijke visuele designs. Je gaat ervaring opdoen in de commerciële sector en leert communiceren in een ervaren team. Je mag meewerken aan projecten voor verschillende nationale en internationale merken. Vereisten Wat breng je mee? Je volgt een relevante mbo- of hbo- opleiding in de richting van illustratie, grafisch ontwerp of een vergelijkbare creatieve studie. Je hebt een divers portfolio met verschillende illustratiestijlen en visuele uitingen die relevant zijn voor de commerciële markt. Je bent leergierig, creatief en kunt goed samenwerken in een team. Je hebt affiniteit met design en oog voor detail. Basiskennis van design software zoals Adobe Illustrator en Photoshop. Je bent beschikbaar voor een stageperiode van minimaal 4 maanden. jobs.description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the South Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have. Votre mission est simple : présenter aux indépendants, commerçants, artisans, professions libérales et entreprises une solution leur permettant de simplifier la gestion de leurs encaissements et de leurs opérations financières. Vous recommandez, nous vous accompagnons et vous percevez des commissions sur les clients professionnels apportés et validés. UNE RÉMUNÉRATION ATTRACTIVE 150 € PAR NOUVEAU CLIENT PROFESSIONNEL Pour chaque professionnel recommandé qui ouvre un compte éligible et remplit les conditions de validation, vous percevez une commission de 150 € . Et ce n'est pas tout ! Une rémunération complémentaire récurrente peut également vous être proposée, à hauteur de 0,15 % des transactions éligibles réalisées pendant 12 mois , selon les conditions du programme. DES AVANTAGES MAJEURS POUR DÉVELOPPER VOTRE ACTIVITÉ 1. Votre propre site internet dédié Nous mettons à votre disposition un site de présentation professionnel, conçu pour promouvoir l'offre et faciliter la prise de contact avec vos prospects. 2. Des visuels commerciaux prêts à l'emploi Bannières, illustrations, supports promotionnels et contenus de communication pour vos démarches commerciales. 3. jobs.title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll? 🚀 Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz. Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source . Über die Rolle Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen. Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren will

By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding. Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals. 🎯 Your mission You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product . You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs. jobs.title: Mechanical Analyses Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. We want you as a talented Mechanical Analyses Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our vehicle. You will work closely with our CAD, thermal and mechanism engineers to optimize together the vehicle mechanical design. You will be part of the Nyx Design Office and will report to the Principal Mechanical Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Own the mechanical design of primary and secondary structures of the vehicle. Drive mass optimization strategies while maintaining structural integrity and compliance with mission requirements. Design and analyze both metallic and composite structures using advanced materials (e.g., space-graded aluminum alloys, CFRP, honeycomb panels). Define material selection and consider manufacturing constraints in the design. Support the structural development collaborating with external suppliers, from concept to delivery. Develop and manage technical specifications, statements of work, and interface control documents. Ensure supplier designs meet performance, quality, and schedule requirements. Contribute to the overall mechanical architecture of the spacecraft. Ensure proper integration of structural components with other subsystems (thermal, avionics...). Perform or oversee structural analyses (FEA) to validate designs under launch, orbital and reentry environments. Support environmental testing and qualification campaigns. Generate detailed design documentation and verification plans. Ensure compliance with relevant space industry standards (e.g., ECSS, NASA, ISO). What We Would Love to See from You Qualifications: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Enginee

jobs.description: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.  The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. jobs.title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth. You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient. This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. jobs.description: We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne . The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture. Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden. Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com. Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit. jobs.description: Vacature: Marketing director (B2B SaaS/fintech) @ Snelstart Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart ( www.snelstart.nl ) in Amersfoort zoekt Sound People een marketing director die marketingstrategie, executie en teamontwikkeling verbindt. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland. Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen. De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart. · Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie. · Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content). · Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales. · Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen. · Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata. · Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat. · Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in. · Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV). Wat biedt Snelstart jou? · Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring. · 30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur) · Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland. · Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage. · Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten. · Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid. · Een betrokken en dynamisch team. Wat is de procedure? Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelS

jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products. What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature. We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet. You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner). About the Role and How We Work Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. jobs.description: Nash is looking for a Technical Support Specialist to join our global, 24/7 Technical Support team. This role sits at the heart of how Nash stabilizes the platform for our enterprise merchants - owning the investigation, resolution, and clean escalation of complex platform and integration issues across our delivery orchestration system. Technical Support is Nash's intake and stabilization layer for everything beyond high-volume delivery inquiries. You'll be the person customers and internal teams rely on when something unusual is happening on the platform: a stuck integration, an unexpected provider behavior, a configuration question that needs real investigation. You'll resolve what you can, escalate what you can't with the context needed to move quickly, and help build the knowledge base that makes the next occurrence faster. This is a role for someone who enjoys the detective work of complex, ambiguous technical problems, communicates clearly under pressure, and takes ownership seriously. LOCATION Remote in UK (required) UK Time (GMT / BST): Thursday - Monday, 9A - 6P TRAINING 4 weeks, Monday - Friday A note on location This is a remote role, but candidates must be located in the UK. This is a hard requirement driven by contractual data access obligations with our enterprise customers, not a preference - we are not able to make exceptions. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Platform and integration investigation. Diagnose configuration questions, known error patterns, API and webhook issues, and account-specific behavior across the Nash platform. Escalation quality. When an issue needs Engineering or Enterprise Operations, you own the handoff — clear reproduction steps, investigation performed, impact assessment, and severity. Escalations from this team are expected to be actionable on arrival. Incident coordination. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group About the role. We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant. When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers. How you embrace curiosity daily. Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities. Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues. Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes. Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability. Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams. Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs. How you make your mark. Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant. Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance. Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity. Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements

Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry. We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority. jobs.description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Production pour rejoindre notre équipe Art de Vivre & Senteurs à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Décembre 2026.. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Rattaché(e) aux Chefs de Production, vos principales responsabilités seront : PRODUCTION : Réception et vérification des prototypes puis mise à jour du suivi de production ; Participation au pilotage et respect des plannings de production ; Contact quotidien avec les fournisseurs sur l’ensemble de ces sujets ; Référencement des fiches produits et des bons de commandes dans notre ERP ; Commande du labelling, packaging, fournitures, appro matières, et dispatch aux fournisseurs ; Dépôt des modèles. PRÉPARATION DES VENTES : Demande auprès des usines des shooting samples et suivi de leur réception ; Revue des fiches produit et du plan de collection en vue de la mise en ligne. Requirements

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description: Make security the reason people trust Ockto Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture. As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide. What you'll do You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you: Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible. Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to. Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time. Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence

We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We hebben meer dan 90 collega’s op kantoren in Nijverdal en Zwolle. Ons platform wordt dagelijks gebruikt in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken, en we willen heel Europa veroveren. Met zo’n snelle groei liggen er veel vragen klaar waar nog niemand goed antwoord op heeft. Daar zoeken we jou voor. De opdracht We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert. Ontwerpvraag (startpunt): Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen: • AI en kennisdeling: hoe zetten we AI in om klanten en gebruikers te helpen, bijvoorbeeld met cursussen of leercontent in de 12Build Academy?. • Groei en leadgeneratie: hoe trekken we meer nieuwe klanten aan en volgen we leads slimmer op, bijvoorbeeld met lead scoring of automatisering?. • Self-service: hoe zorgen we dat gebruikers zelf de weg vinden op het platform en sneller een betalend account nemen?. • Internationale groei: hoe pakken we een nieuwe markt aan en wat werkt in Nederland wel of juist niet in Duitsland of Denemarken?. • Klantbeleving en data: hoe halen we meer uit klantdata, reviews en feedback om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren?. • Jouw eigen idee: zie je een kans die hier niet tussen staat?
